message: India's crude-oil supply chain is currently experiencing a shortage due to disruptions on the Strait of Hormuz corridor, but efforts are underway to manage the situation. We encourage citizens to remain calm and take small steps to conserve energy.
conservation_plan: Reduce non-essential travel and consider carpooling or using public transport
Switch to energy-efficient appliances and turn off lights, fans, and electronics when not in use
Plan your daily activities to minimize fuel consumption and support the nation's energy conservation efforts
